title: CodeRabbit follow-ups: what omitting a flag does not guarantee
description: Three fixes from CodeRabbit's late review of #4117. Not passing the credits flag avoids spend only when the org's usage-based add-on is On demand or Off, since Automatic bills overages. The linter block moves from a root tools key, which schema v2 rejects, to reviews.tools. The zero-reviews doc records that the app now reviews this repo. Pick a billing mode and toggle the config before and after.
